name: albahjah-manasik-umroh-bumper
description: AL-BAHJAH MANASIK UMROH - 40s cinematic event bumper built with Remotion

scripts.finalize: ffmpeg -y -i out/ALBAHJAH_MANASIK_UMROH_BUMPER_40S.mp4 -vf scale=in_range=full:out_range=tv,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 16 -profile:v high -color_range tv -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -movflags +faststart -c:a copy renders/ALBAHJAH_MANASIK_UMROH_BUMPER_40S.mp4
scripts.finalize:keyvisual: ffmpeg -y -i out/ALBAHJAH_MANASIK_UMROH_KEYVISUAL_10S.mp4 -vf scale=in_range=full:out_range=tv,format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 15 -profile:v high -color_range tv -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -movflags +faststart -c:a aac -b:a 320k -t 10 renders/ALBAHJAH_MANASIK_UMROH_KEYVISUAL_10S.mp4
